Add comprehensive backend infrastructure for BSG Demo Platform

This commit implements a complete FastAPI-based backend according to the
common-infrastructure.md requirements, including:

Core Services:
- Configuration service with environment variable support and validation
- Structured JSON logging with correlation IDs and audit trails
- Database service with SQLAlchemy 2.0, connection pooling, and health checks
- Common utilities for validation, encryption, and date/time handling

Authentication & Authorization:
- JWT-based authentication with access and refresh tokens
- User registration, login, logout, and token refresh endpoints
- Role-based access control (RBAC) with admin/user/guest roles
- Session management with user tracking
- Secure password hashing with bcrypt

API Infrastructure:
- FastAPI application with OpenAPI/Swagger documentation
- Comprehensive error handling middleware with standardized responses
- Request logging middleware with correlation IDs
- Security headers middleware (HSTS, CSP, etc.)
- Rate limiting middleware (in-memory, supports Redis)
- CORS configuration
- Authentication dependencies and decorators

Database Models:
- User model with roles, verification, and password reset
- User session model for refresh token management
- Alembic configuration for database migrations

Video Storage:
- Video upload service with file validation
- HTTP range-based video streaming for efficient playback
- Component-based organization
- Support for multiple video formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm)

Health & Monitoring:
- Comprehensive health check endpoint with component status
- Kubernetes-compatible readiness and liveness probes
- Basic metrics endpoint for monitoring
- Database pool metrics

Deployment:
- Dockerfile for containerized deployment
- docker-compose.yml with PostgreSQL and Redis
- Startup scripts (start.sh/start.bat) with Docker/Podman auto-detection
- .env.example with all configuration options documented
- Comprehensive backend README with setup instructions

All components follow security best practices, include proper error handling,
and are designed to be production-ready with horizontal scalability support.
